lego.distinct_views_definition: Count of different camera keys satisfying visible_mass>=0.1, rim_mass>=0.01 and rim_mass/visible_mass>=0.12. It is not raw pixel votes, pixel count, or summed alphaT mass.
lego.fusion_definition: Per-ID maximum regularized relative responsiveness plus single-hop 3D hysteresis, not repeated-view vote summation.

display_sampling.rule: Sort original IDs ascending; choose integer indices linspace(0,n-1,min(12000,n)). Every displayed ID saved; these plots are deterministic samples, not full selected sets or footprints.

lego.semantic_status: Kernel-support diagnostics, not certified physical edges; world-center plot is not the rendered region asset.
